# Aihu

> A complete meta-framework for the agentic web. Write .aihu SFCs — the Rust compiler emits Web Components + MCP tool schemas. Sub-2 kB reactive runtime.

## Getting Started

- [Quickstart](https://aihu.dev/#getting-started): Install the CLI and scaffold a new app in 3 minutes
- [Installation](https://aihu.dev/#installation): Prerequisites and install instructions
- [Hello World](https://aihu.dev/#getting-started): The minimal .aihu SFC — state, template, agent surface

## Core Documentation

- [Authoring Components](https://aihu.dev/#authoring-components): @state, @template, @style block syntax, reactive macros, and common diagnostics (C204, C205, W210)
- [Reactivity](https://aihu.dev/#reactivity): signal(), computed(), effect() — the push-based reactive core
- [Authoring Agents](https://aihu.dev/#authoring-agents): @agent block, MCP tool schema generation, live-binding
- [Styling](https://aihu.dev/#styling): @aihu/css-engine — Tailwind v4 hard fork, WC-native scoped output, cn(), style packs, build-time/zero-bundle
- [Theming](https://aihu.dev/#theming): @aihu/css-engine design tokens — aihu-default / aihu-graphite style packs, defineStylePack() for custom orgs, :root + .dark emission
- [Primitives](https://aihu.dev/#primitives): @aihu/primitives — headless WAI-ARIA APG behaviors (dialog, tooltip, button) as vanilla custom elements, zero CSS
- [Routing & Layouts](https://aihu.dev/#routing-layouts): File-based routing with @route block and viteRouterIntegration
- [Data Fetching](https://aihu.dev/#data-fetching): $resource macro and server loaders
- [Authoring Plugins](https://aihu.dev/#authoring-plugins): definePlugin contract and plugin ecosystem
- [SSR & Hydration](https://aihu.dev/#ssr-hydration): Server rendering and client hydration
- [Migration (v0 → v1)](https://aihu.dev/#migration): Upgrade pre-v1 SFCs — @props→$prop:, read props via $computed, $html, $-prefixed bindings, npx aihu migrate
- [Deployment](https://aihu.dev/#deployment): Cloudflare, Vercel, Bun, and Deno adapters

## API Reference

- [API Reference](https://aihu.dev/#api-reference): @aihu/signals, @aihu/arbor, @aihu/runtime, @aihu/router, @aihu/server, @aihu/agent, @aihu-plugin/agent-readiness, @aihu/css-engine, @aihu/primitives

## Agent & MCP

- [MCP Server Card](https://aihu.dev/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Machine-readable MCP server card (SEP-1649)
- [llms-full.txt](https://aihu.dev/llms-full.txt): Extended documentation for AI agents
- [llms-cookbook.txt](https://github.com/aihu-project/aihu/blob/main/llms-cookbook.txt): Compiler-verified cookbook recipes — the fluency corpus for writing idiomatic .aihu components (generated from cookbook/)

## Source

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/aihu-project/aihu): Source code, examples, and specs
- [Component and Extension Registry](https://aihu.dev/registry): Source-distributed UI recipes and first-party extension packages
- [Registry JSON](https://aihu.dev/registry/index.json): Machine-readable catalog with inlined recipe source
- [npm: @aihu/signals](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@aihu/signals): Reactive primitive package
- [npm: @aihu/cli](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@aihu/cli): CLI scaffold tool
